Blood and Organ Management System: 
The Blood and Organ Management System is a Python-based application designed to streamline the management of blood 
and organ donations in hospitals and healthcare organizations. It helps track donor information, blood group availability, 
organ inventory, and recipient details. This system improves the efficiency, accuracy, and accessibility of donation-related 
data, ensuring timely and life-saving matches between donors and recipients. Developed using Python, along with tools like 
Tkinter or Flask, it features an intuitive interface for administrators and healthcare workers to manage records with ease.
